impressions.text: The delivery is agent-orchestration developer tooling in vworlds/vmethod: fixes for merge-task completion markers and issue linking plus new orchestrator `issue create`/`issue close` and `board set` verbs, bundled at the owner's agreement after the first live merge-task run surfaced three bugs.

Model codexbal/gpt-6.1-sol delivered the merged outcome in a single round, but only after stopping with an authenticated QUESTION on whether `open-task` should normalize the unsupported `bug:` title prefix to `fix:` or extend accepted delivery-title types, explicitly refusing to broaden merge acceptance without that decision.

The orchestrator's ANSWER resolved that stop by mapping the issue-only `bug:` alias to `fix:` without extending accepted delivery-title types, requiring coverage of all three title paths including the live `bug:` reproducer.

The worker's reported strength is regressions-first verification: the live title alias, REST `null` diagnostic, marker and branch-fallback suites failed before implementation, and all required gates exited 0, including 479 tests across 39 files, packed smoke, and a live read-only `gh-read` of issue 37 returning verified data through the built CLI instead of `null`.

Review caught nothing further: owner review independently confirmed CI green at head `526b3e69d3adfe398193ff8bd66d862fea52d132`, ran live write smoke through the new verbs (temporary item 42 created, item 39's existing Estimate value 5 written, a checked comment posted, the item completed and read back closed), reported no remaining review findings, and the PR was merged on 2026-10-17.

findings.text: Out-of-scope observation left for triage: the fixture-recording diagnostic query dropped `repository { nameWithOwner }` without `owner { login }`, and adding that owner selection returned the accepted issue.
